topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: High-gain SIW arrays in inter-satellite antennas face a trade-off: larger arrays enhance gain but increase radiation losses, impacting efficiency. Smaller arrays offer higher efficiency but narrower radiation patterns, potentially causing interference. Optimal array size depends on frequency range and desired performance, requiring careful consideration of feeding techniques and thermal effects.  A hybrid SiW waveguide power divider balances compact design and efficiency, maximizing performance across various frequencies.
